items.description: Tree items. Every item sets `type`: "link" ({href, text}) renders a Link; "details" renders a Details with `summaryProps` and either `items` (a nested Tree) or `text` (a paragraph); "text" ({text}) renders a plain label. Link and Details options can be passed on their respective items. Each nested items array uses the same shape.
A link, details, or text item, chosen by `type`.

type.description: Required. Selects how the item renders.

text.description: Link text, plain label text, or details paragraph text.

summaryProps.description: Props passed to the Details summary. Only for type "details".

items.description: Nested Tree items shown inside the Details, including an empty array. Only for type "details"; use instead of text.

name.description: Native Details group name; give sibling details items the same name for exclusive opening. Only for type "details".

variant.description: Default keeps Details styling without a variant class; padded adds row spacing, alignment, and an interactive hover surface. The variant applies to every nested list.

className.description: Additional classes for the ul element.
